display_fil: Kaso: May matinding sakit sa tagiliran si Paolo at kaunti ang ihi
display_en: Case: Paolo has severe side pain and little urine
narration_fil: May matinding sakit sa tagiliran si Paolo at kaunti ang ihi. Tinanong niya ang tungkol sa Sambong.
narration_en: Paolo has severe side pain and little urine. He asks about Sambong.

narration_fil: Sa reference card, hanapin ang Blumea balsamifera. Ang nakalistang bahagi ay dahon; ang paksang gamit ay pag-aalaga sa kidney-stone concern sa payo ng clinician. Sabihin kung ano ang alam at hindi alam. Itanong ang kasalukuyang gamot at sintomas. Ipasuri agad ang matinding sakit at pagbabago sa pag-ihi sa health facility.
narration_en: Find Blumea balsamifera on the reference card. The listed part is leaves; the use topic is kidney-stone concern under clinical advice. State what is known and unknown. Ask about current medicine and symptoms. Seek prompt facility assessment for severe pain and changed urination.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Sambong ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Sambong part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng halaman sa bakuran kahit hindi ito nakumpirmang Sambong.
options.en: Any part of a yard plant even when its identity as Sambong is unconfirmed.

options.fil: Hindi kailangang malaman ang botanical name.
options.en: The botanical name need not be checked.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi ligtas ang hindi nakumpirmang bahagi at pagkakakilanlan. 2: Itugma ang bahagi sa nakasulat na source; hindi pa ito dose. 3: Magkapareho ang tawag sa ilang magkakaibang halaman.
check.feedback_en: 1: Unconfirmed part and identity are unsafe. 2: Match the part to the written source; this is not a dose. 3: Common names may cover different plants.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

narration_fil: Itinuro ng BHW ang Sambong at botanical name sa card. Hindi niya pinaghulaang tama ang halamang nasa bakuran. Ipasuri agad ang matinding sakit at pagbabago sa pag-ihi sa health facility.
narration_en: The BHW points to Sambong and its botanical name on the card. The yard plant is not assumed to be identified. Seek prompt facility assessment for severe pain and changed urination.

narration_fil: Hindi mapatutunayan ng sintomas lamang na kidney stone ito. Huwag ipagpaliban ang pagsusuri para sa pinagpakuluan. Hindi awtorisasyon ang lesson na ito para maghanda o mag-dose ng halamang gamot.
narration_en: Symptoms alone do not establish a kidney stone. Do not delay assessment for a decoction. This lesson does not authorize preparation or dosing of an herbal remedy.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang ligtas na sagot sa kaso ni Sambong?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe response in the Sambong case?

options.fil: Gayahin ang lumang timpla nang walang pagsusuri.
options.en: Copy an old recipe without assessment.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring maantala o mapalitan ang kinakailangang pangangalaga. 2: Kumpirmahin ang identity, sintomas at saklaw bago magpayo. 3: Hindi kapalit ng kasalukuyang clinical guidance ang lumang timpla.
check.feedback_en: 1: Necessary care may be displaced or delayed. 2: Confirm identity, symptoms and scope before advice. 3: An old recipe does not replace current clinical guidance.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ihambing ang dalawang card na may pangalang Sambong. Markahan ang botanical name, dahon, nakalistang gamit at referral. Ipasuri ang card sa supervisor.
narration_en: On Monday, compare two cards labelled Sambong. Mark the botanical name, leaves, listed use and referral. Review the card with a supervisor.
